protocol.name: glassine_ink_v1

description.summary: pen ink areas for the e-ink panel

protocol.description: On a GlassineOS device the panel engine draws a pen stroke itself, straight from the pen's events, long before the app's own rendering arrives (the app's frame then replaces it). This protocol lets an app tell the compositor where on its surfaces the pen draws: its canvas, not its toolbar. The compositor removes every part covered by other surfaces (menus, the shell, the keyboard, other windows). Without it, an app whose per-app setting has ink on gets its whole visible window.

request.name: get_ink_surface
request.description: At most one per wl_surface (a second one is a protocol error).

entry.name: already_exists
entry.summary: the surface has an ink object

request.name: create_brush

description.summary: a brush the panel engine stamps along the stroke

request.description: A declarative brush: a tip (a disc or the app's own coverage masks), spacing, dynamics curves, scatter, ink grey level and blend. The panel engine stamps it on the CPU right at the pen's tip; the app's own frame replaces the preview later, so it only has to look close. Select it with glassine_ink_surface_v1.set_brush_object. A fresh brush is a hard black disc (hardness 1, spacing 0.25, ink, grey 0, opacity 255, darken).

description.summary: back to the window's default (its per-app setting)

request.name: set_areas

description.summary: where the pen draws, in surface coordinates

request.description: The region is copied: later changes to the wl_region don't apply. An empty region: the pen draws nowhere on this window. Null: back to the default (the whole window if its per-app setting has ink on). Takes effect with the compositor's next frame.

entry.name: tip
entry.summary: the pen's tip

entry.name: eraser
entry.summary: the pen's eraser end

entry.name: default
entry.summary: back to the per-app setting (eink.conf brush=/eraser=)

entry.name: none
entry.summary: no preview: the app's frame shows the stroke

entry.name: pen
entry.summary: a black stroke

entry.name: erase
entry.summary: whitens: an eraser that removes ink

request.name: set_brush

description.summary: the preview's stroke for this surface's areas

request.description: What the panel engine draws for the given end of the pen while the app's frame is on its way: match it to the app's current tool so the preview and the app's rendering agree. Widths are diameters in surface coordinates (so a zoomed canvas sends its zoomed width): width_min at no pressure, width_max at full pressure, pressure^pressure_exponent in between. The preview is black or white only (an e-ink fast update): send none for light colours, highlighters and tools that don't draw. Takes effect with the compositor's next frame, for strokes that start after it.

request.name: set_brush_object

description.summary: a declarative brush for one end of the pen

request.description: Like set_brush with kind pen (or erase, by the brush's ink kind), with the brush's tip, curves, scatter and ink. The widths are the diameter range as in set_brush (surface coordinates; the brush's pressure_size curve, if set, replaces pressure^pressure_exponent). The compositor snapshots the brush at its next frame: later changes to the brush object apply when it is selected again or at the compositor's next frame after the change, for strokes that start after it. A null brush is set_brush(tool, default). Destroying a selected brush keeps the snapshot in force until the next set_brush/set_brush_object.

interface.name: glassine_ink_brush_v1
interface.description: Limits (a protocol error past them): tip size 1..64 px, 1..16 variants, at most 8 brushes per client in use at once (selected on a surface). Fractions and the curve values are clamped to their ranges.

entry.name: bad_tip
entry.summary: tip size, variant count or fd size out of range

entry.name: bad_curve
entry.summary: a curve array that is not 16 bytes

entry.name: too_many
entry.summary: more than 8 brushes in use

request.name: set_shape
request.description: hardness 0..1: 1 = a hard disc (the default), lower = a soft edge (coverage falls off linearly from hardness*radius to the radius); ignored for a mask tip. spacing: the distance between dabs as a fraction of the current diameter (0.02..4; 0.25 default). elongation 0.05..1: the dab's minor/major axis ratio (1 = round; a calligraphy nib ~0.2). angle: degrees, of the major axis, by angle_mode.

entry.name: fixed
entry.summary: angle is absolute (in surface orientation): a calligraphy nib

entry.name: direction
entry.summary: angle is added to the stroke's direction

entry.name: tilt
entry.summary: angle is added to the pen's tilt direction (fixed when the pen reports no tilt)

request.name: set_tip
request.description: fd: size*size*variants bytes (read-only mapping suffices), one 8-bit coverage mask after the other, row-major, 255 = full ink, 0 = none. Each dab picks a variant at random (per-stroke seed). The mask is scaled (nearest) to the current diameter and rotated by the dab angle. Rendering it yourself is the escape hatch for any brush look (textures, pencil grain, chalk). size 0: back to the disc. The fd is read at once and closed by the compositor.

entry.name: ink
entry.summary: the dabs draw

entry.name: erase
entry.summary: the dabs whiten (an eraser): blend is ignored, white replaces

entry.name: none
entry.summary: no preview (the app's frame shows it)

entry.name: darken
entry.summary: min(old, ink): ink, a highlighter keeps text under it

entry.name: lighten
entry.summary: max(old, ink): a soft eraser

entry.name: replace
entry.summary: the ink's level replaces what is there (opaque paint)

request.name: set_ink

entry.name: pressure_size
entry.summary: pressure -> diameter (0 = width_min, 255 = width_max)

entry.name: pressure_opacity
entry.summary: pressure -> opacity multiplier (255 = 1)

entry.name: velocity_size
entry.summary: speed (0 .. ~450 mm/s) -> diameter multiplier (128 = 1, 255 = ~2)

entry.name: tilt_size
entry.summary: tilt (0 = upright .. 90 degrees) -> diameter multiplier (128 = 1)

request.name: set_curve
request.description: points: 16 bytes, the curve's value at input 0, 1/15 .. 15/15 of its range, linear in between. An empty array removes the curve (back to the default: pressure_size = pressure^pressure_exponent of set_brush, 1 for exponent-less brushes; the others flat at 1).

request.name: set_scatter
request.description: count 0..8 extra dabs per spaced step, each offset by up to position_jitter diameters (0..2) and resized by up to +-size_jitter (0..1) and its opacity scaled by 1-opacity_jitter*rand (0..1). Airbrush: count 4, position_jitter 0.6, opacity low.
